aborted_unresolved.description: Recording aborted while the last frame was still in the encoder: acquired+submitted with no terminal event and no video message; Close says aborted with unresolved=1.

b_frame.description: Real x264 main-profile stream containing B slices.

calibration_reset.description: Calibration reset supersedes rgb_0 at frame 2 but later frames keep rgb_0.

channel_encoding_cdr_message.description: Pose channel message encoding is CDR, not cdr.

channel_encoding_cdr_schema.description: Pose channel schema encoding is ros2idl, not ros2msg.

channel_encoding_json_message.description: FrameEvent channel message encoding is JSON, not json.

channel_encoding_json_schema.description: FrameEvent channel schema encoding is JSONSCHEMA, not jsonschema.

channel_encoding_video_message.description: Video channel message encoding is PROTOBUF, not protobuf.

channel_encoding_video_schema.description: Video channel schema encoding is flatbuffer, not protobuf.

close_count_mismatch.description: Final close frame counts disagree with observed lifecycle events.

completed_with_unresolved.description: Close says completed although the last frame never reached a terminal state.

config_only.description: First video message carries only SPS/PPS, not an image.

delayed.description: Same capture times; a 400 ms encoder/output stall after frame 1 delays delivery and terminal frame events (logged after later acquisitions). Capture time is preserved.

descriptor_hash.description: Embedded Protobuf descriptor bytes differ from the pinned complete descriptor.

drop_reason_mismatch.description: Close attributes the dropped frame to a different reason than its dropped event.

dropped_identity_mismatch.description: Dropped FrameEvent for source frame 3 changes the native clock id of the acquired event.

duplicate_output_sequence.description: Two written frames share MCAP output sequence 1 (and two video messages share it).

duplicate_pts.description: Two source frames share one encoder PTS.

failed_unresolved.description: Encoder failure left the last frame unresolved; Close says failed with a failure_reason.

failed_without_reason.description: Close outcome failed without a failure_reason.

idr_with_config.description: Single complete IDR access unit including SPS/PPS.

legacy_jpeg.description: Historical sensor_msgs CompressedImage JPEG capture; explicitly classified, never admitted as h264_mcap_v1.

malformed_cdr.description: Pose message has an invalid CDR encapsulation header.

malformed_json.description: Inventory evidence message is not valid JSON.

malformed_protobuf_length.description: Video message declares a 1000-byte data field but ends after one byte.

malformed_protobuf_wire_type.description: Video message uses the unsupported Protobuf wire type 7.

missing_pts.description: A frame event omits its encoder PTS.

motion_count_mismatch.description: Close reports 3 accelerometer events but only 2 were recorded.

multiple_access_units.description: One message carries two complete access units (an access unit must be exactly one image).

pose_schema_identity.description: PoseStamped ros2msg text differs from the reviewed pinned definition.

pts_not_integer.description: Encoder PTS of source frame 2 is the non-integer string 33333.5 in every event.

ros2_profile.description: Mixed Protobuf/CDR/JSON file falsely claims the ROS2 MCAP profile.

schema_malformed_frame_event.description: A submitted FrameEvent carries native_timestamp_ns as a JSON number instead of a decimal string.

sensor_count_mismatch.description: Close reports 5 sensor events but 2 were recorded.

time_base_mismatch.description: All events of source frame 2 declare time base 1/90000 instead of 1/1000000.

tracking_loss.description: A pose marked lost is still presented as valid.

truncated_mid_record.description: Cut inside the final record: no footer.

unequal_clock.description: Frame events use a native clock other than the declared rgb stream clock.

valid.description: Baseline Annex B IDR+P stream, one dropped frame, independent IMU clocks, CDR pose, tracking-loss marked invalid.

written_calibration_mismatch.description: Written FrameEvent switches to calibration rgb_1 without a reset event.

written_capture_time_mismatch.description: Written FrameEvent changes the mapped capture time by 1 ns; the video message still carries the acquired time.

written_pts_mismatch.description: Written FrameEvent for source frame 1 carries encoder PTS 33334 instead of the acquired 33333.
